integrity: All formulas derived by finite combinatorial inclusion-exclusion, partition Möbius inversion, and standard quadratic Gauss sums. Direct finite-field enumeration is corroborative, not a proof of an infinite identity. No independent mathematical audit or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only finite fields of characteristic p>5; mean over the quadratic and linear coefficients, not individual image histograms, and no degrees other than five. Earliest motivating article first publicly posted 2013-06-07. Closest historical sources present estimates or uncomputed inclusion-exclusion identities; other exact specializations may exist outside inspected literature.
title: Exact quadratic-character strata for average value sets of fixed-coefficient quintics
